chapter: Wynn: New York and Chicago bands
title: Jesse Stone, Grand Terrace and Fletcher Henderson
summary: Back in Chicago he worked with Jesse Stone at the Club Morocco, subbed at the Grand Terrace, then Jimmie Noone and Fletcher Henderson.

story.theme_name: Chicago: the jazz migration and its clubs
story.community_name: Going north: working the Chicago jazz scene

blocks.x: Well, we got the end of that story. And that's just something else that you think ought to be told, especially?

Well, there's nothing other than that when I come to Chicago. Nothing very much was happening here. I went with Jesse Stone. We finally got a band together and opened a new spot here, the Club Morocco. But they had a lot of hometown boys that didn't want to go any place. It was discontented. Never the type of Jimmy Noon now. Yeah, Jimmy Noon eventually went in the same place. So, uh, in the meantime, I leave Jimmy Stone and go with Carol Dixon as a replacement at the Grand Terrace when Earl would go out on the road. So I went down there and worked. And then Jimmy Noon got this job in the Club Morocco. So I went with Jimmy. And I worked with him until I joined Fletcher. I joined Fletcher Henderson. And I was with him until the time he broke up his band going with Benny Goodman.
